name: Job Hunt Copilot
tagline: Paste your CV once, score any job in 30 seconds — tailored bullets, cover letter, interview pack.
description: Job Hunt Copilot turns 60 minutes of tailoring into 10. Save your CV (paste text, upload a file, or try a LinkedIn URL), paste any job description, and get a fit score with matched and missing keywords, paste-ready mirrored bullets, a forward-looking cover letter, and an interview prep pack mapped to your proof. Every application is tracked in a pipeline with 10-day follow-up nudges — drafts only, never auto-send. Honest by design: gaps get bridge lines marked [ADD IF TRUE], never invented experience.
